updates.text: Started ptmpatch: a PHP web application providing user authentication, cron jobs, and AJAX‑driven question management for an exercise platform.
Implemented PDO with bound parameters, removed bundled libraries, and switched to Composer‑managed PHPMailer and .env configuration.
Started ascend90: a static web app that tracks a 90‑day transformation plan across six pillars, using Groq AI to coach and roast the user, storing data in localStorage.
Added offline service worker, web app manifest, icons, and integrated Groq AI coach with prayer‑time fetch, game rules, and localStorage persistence.

Started afterburner: a 3D fighter jet simulator using Panda3D, featuring a physically based rendering pipeline, a high‑detail Su‑57 model, and an edge‑of‑space world with realistic lighting and atmosphere.
Implemented realistic Earth day map with Milky Way sky, enabled PBR rendering, and added high‑detail Su‑57 glTF model for edge‑of‑space flight.
Started wingman: android app that reads Tinder/Bumble chats via Accessibility Service, drafts replies with Groq API, and auto‑sends them at psychologically timed moments.
Implemented auto‑open of dating app when a reply is due, added human‑like typing, and enabled vision‑optional Groq model.
